Another thing to think about is the intention behind my actions. I didn't want to have a heavy conversation, especially since I was already feeling down about my own fertility issues. My intention was to keep the mood light and enjoy the time with my friends. But the way I went about it might have been insensitive to M's feelings. But by that point, M was already tearful and upset, so maybe I should have handled it differently from the start. Perhaps instead of abruptly shifting the subject, I could have acknowledged M's feelings and then gently steered the conversation elsewhere. That way, I would have validated her emotions without letting the conversation become too heavy. In the end, the evening was ruined, and M left upset. That's not what I wanted, so I have to take responsibility for my actions. While my intention was to keep things light, my method of doing so was insensitive and led to a negative outcome. So, in conclusion, I think I was wrong in how I handled the situation. My approach was too abrupt and dismissive, which hurt M's feelings and ruined the evening for everyone involved. I should have been more considerate of her emotions and found a kinder way to shift the conversation if I felt it was necessary.
